camel_example: aliyun cr CreateRepoSourceCodeRepo --region cn-hangzhou --CodeRepoNamespaceName namespace --InstanceId 'cri-shac42yvqzvq0000' --CodeRepoName repo --CodeRepoType GITHUB --RepoId 'crr-gzsrlevmvoaq0000'
description_en: Binds a source code repository to an image repository
description_zh: 给镜像仓库绑定源代码仓库
kebab_example: aliyun cr create-repo-source-code-repo --instance-id cri-shac42yvqzvq0000 --repo-id crr-gzsrlevmvoaq0000 --code-repo-type GITHUB --code-repo-namespace-name namespace --code-repo-name repo --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRepoSourceCodeRepo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image repository
parameters.name: repo_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the source code hosting platform. Valid values: `GITHUB`, `GITLAB`, `GITEE`, `CODE`, and `CODEUP`
parameters.name: code_repo_type

parameters.help_en: The namespace to which the source code repository belongs
parameters.help_zh: 源代码仓库命名空间名称
parameters.name: code_repo_namespace_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the source code repository
parameters.name: code_repo_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to trigger image building when source code is committed. Valid values:

`true`: triggers image building when source code is committed.
`false`: does not trigger image building when source code is committed
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动构建，取值：

`true`：自动构建

`false`：不自动构建
parameters.name: auto_build

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Build With Servers Deployed Outside Chinese Mainland. Valid values:

`true`: enables Build With Servers Deployed Outside Chinese Mainland.
`false`: does not enable Build With Servers Deployed Outside Chinese Mainland
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启海外源智能构建加速，取值：
`true`：开启海外源智能构建加速

`false`：不开启海外源智能构建加速
parameters.name: oversea_build

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable building caches. Valid values:

`true`: disables building caches.
`false`: enables building caches
parameters.help_zh:
是否关闭构建缓存，取值：

`true`：关闭构建缓存

`false`：开启构建缓存
parameters.name: disable_cache_build
